statement: The survivor is an Evacuee-scenario male character (name read as Timothy Lowery on the character sheet; the memory record says Adkins), starting Spring day 61 at 8:00 AM
An earlier abandoned start in another world had a different character (Elliot Akers) at a stadium; that character was quit and is not the current survivor
The new world has no earlier-created characters beyond the existing worlds Freemont/Rossiter; the new world's name is uncertain (the memory first said Canfield, later corrected to unknown)
The survivor starts in evac shelter B-05, with companion NPC Evan Browne, who has no mission and suggests looking for a farm for food and tools
The smartphone has a flashlight app (battery 53/56) that must be turned on in dark places such as the shelter basement, and turned off in daylight
Outside the shelter's west door are a road/parking area and a field with young trees and shrubs; smashing young trees yields sticks and twigs
A long pointy stick can be crafted from memory (spears recipe group, fabrication skill) using a stick found outside; it is now wielded as the survivor's weapon
A cupboard on the shelter's main floor holds sealed plastic bottles of clean water (2 and 5 bottles, 2 clean water each)

The survivor carries three sealed 500ml plastic bottles each with 2 clean water, plus an empty plastic bottle, protein ration, pocket knife, matchbook (20 matches), smartphone, FEMA pamphlet and messenger bag
Stairs lead down from the shelter to a basement with a main room; items on a basement floor tile included a FEMA pamphlet, paper wrapper, plastic bottle and a protein ration (taken)
The shelter basement bathroom area holds soap bars, bleach, toilet paper, plungers, water and a bathroom scale (toilet water downstairs)

note: Wields the crafted long pointy stick while walking back to the shelter
Flashlight is active in the basement, as seen in the inventory
